value.rationale:
QHM's defining purpose is to separate historical discount \( eta\) from immediate discount \(
u\). The exact formula shows that this extra degree of freedom has a sharp deterministic rate interpretation: the best scalar factor is \(| eta-\sqrt{ eta
u}|/(1-\sqrt{ eta
u})\), and only the Nesterov slice \(
u= eta\) reaches zero. This provides a precise critical-damping benchmark for understanding and testing QHM parameterizations.
